title: compartment-screen: pre-registration and code for a compartment screen on fly connectomes
description:
Pre-registration, frozen code and confirmatory results for a compartment screen on the BANC connectome (release 888).

Registration: release v0.1.0-prereg, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24223802, record created 2026-11-14T15:59:33Z (prereg/PREREG.md, code fixed by prereg/MANIFEST.sha256). The registered analysis was run once, on 14 November 2026 from 16:03 to 16:07 UTC, after the registration. Both registered hypotheses hold in the primary analysis (all edges): the ellipsoid-body set of the central complex is a compartment of the synapse-flow Markov chain (criteria C1 to C4), and the mushroom body and the central complex are preferentially coupled (criterion C5). At a threshold of 5 synapses, which was registered as reported and not scored, C2 and C3 would not hold. Verdicts and every reported number: RESULTS.md; result file and log: results/.

The exploratory analyses behind the registration are in exploratory/ and are not confirmatory.
